request.system_prompt: You are a strict mathematical review auditor. Judge whether each proposed simplification preserves the real-valued function, including its domain and any explicitly declared protected operator semantics. Return only one JSON object matching the requested schema, without markdown.
request.user_prompt:
Review exactly these three proposed simplifications over real variables.
A. original: x + x; proposed: 2*x; domain: all real x.
B. original: sqrt(x**2); proposed: x; domain: all real x; sqrt is ordinary nonnegative real square root.
C. original: protected_sqrt(z), where protected_sqrt(z) is defined as sqrt(abs(z)); proposed: ordinary sqrt(z); domain: all real z.
For each case, verdict must be "pass" iff the proposed expression preserves both values and real domain; otherwise "fail".
Return exactly:
{"cases":[{"id":"A","verdict":"pass"|"fail","reason":"short reason"},{"id":"B","verdict":"pass"|"fail","reason":"short reason"},{"id":"C","verdict":"pass"|"fail","reason":"short reason"}]}

assistant_output_text: {"cases":[{"id":"A","verdict":"pass","reason":"x+x equals 2*x for all real x; same domain."},{"id":"B","verdict":"fail","reason":"sqrt(x**2) equals |x|, which differs from x for negative x."},{"id":"C","verdict":"fail","reason":"protected_sqrt(z)=sqrt(abs(z)) is defined for all real z, while ordinary sqrt(z) is undefined for z<0; domain and values differ."}]}

cases.reason: x+x equals 2*x for all real x; same domain.
sqrt(x**2) equals |x|, which differs from x for negative x.
protected_sqrt(z)=sqrt(abs(z)) is defined for all real z, while ordinary sqrt(z) is undefined for z<0; domain and values differ.
